title: Ankhorage k3s Infrastructure
summary: Adapts portable infrastructure intent to k3s clusters on local Linux or host-key-pinned SSH nodes.
purpose: Provide a standalone k3s runtime adapter while delegating standard Kubernetes workload behavior to the shared Kubernetes driver.
responsibilities: Bootstrap and operate k3s on supported local or SSH-connected nodes.
Compose the shared Kubernetes driver for standard workload projection and reconciliation.
Reconcile Infra-owned Traefik ACME HTTP-01 configuration without replacing foreign Traefik settings.
boundaries: Does not define portable infrastructure contracts.
Does not duplicate standard Kubernetes workload projection owned by @ankhorage/kubernetes.
Does not provide general-purpose SSH orchestration or manage non-k3s clusters.
audience: Infrastructure hosts selecting k3s as a runtime target.
Operators deploying portable workloads to supported k3s nodes.
useCases: Bootstrap a k3s node through the official installer.
Deploy and reconcile a portable workload on k3s.
Configure Infra-owned Traefik ACME HTTP-01 intent on the cluster.

architecture.role: An infrastructure runtime adapter that composes k3s control-plane behavior with the shared Kubernetes driver.
invariants: Standard Kubernetes workload behavior is delegated to the published Kubernetes package.
Remote nodes require host-key-pinned SSH access.
Foreign Traefik configuration is not overwritten.

security: Remote bootstrap requires host-key-pinned SSH access.
limitations: Only the k3s runtime is implemented.
